description: This file defines functions and types for handling compatibility and normalization of anthropic tool payloads within a streaming context, including wrappers for payload processing based on model options.

methods.name: hasOpenAiAnthropicToolPayloadCompatFlag
methods.description: Checks if the model has the openai-anthropic payload compatibility flag set.

methods.name: requiresAnthropicToolPayloadCompatibilityForModel
methods.description: Determines if the model requires anthropic tool payload compatibility based on its api and flags.

methods.name: usesOpenAiFunctionAnthropicToolSchemaForModel
methods.description: Checks if the model uses the openai-functions schema for anthropic tools.

methods.name: usesOpenAiStringModeAnthropicToolChoiceForModel
methods.description: Checks if the model uses openai-string-modes for tool choice.

methods.name: normalizeOpenAiFunctionAnthropicToolDefinition
methods.description: Normalizes a tool definition object into a standard function schema.

methods.name: normalizeOpenAiStringModeAnthropicToolChoice
methods.description: Normalizes a tool choice object into a standard format.

methods.name: createAnthropicToolPayloadCompatibilityWrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper around a stream function to handle payload compatibility based on model options.

methods.name: createOpenAIAnthropicToolPayloadCompatibilityWrapper
methods.description: Creates a specific wrapper with predefined options for openai-functions schema and string modes.
